model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for different fine-tuned models, comparing the performance of Mistralv0.2-Base and its fine-tuned versions on various medical specialties. The horizontal axis represents the per-specialty terms, labeled as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, while the vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" with a linear scale ranging from -27 to -22. Each group of bars corresponds to a specific per-specialty term, and within each group, there are six bars representing the Mistralv0.2-Base model and its fine-tuned versions on different specialties, indicated by distinct colors: light peach for Cardio, peach for Gastro, orange for Infect, brown for Neuro, dark brown for Obstetrics, and dark peach for Pediatrics. The bars are grouped by per-specialty terms, with the height of each bar representing the negative log probability, and the values range from approximately -26.5 for the Cardio term with the Mistralv0.2-Base model to around -22.5 for various terms with their respective fine-tuned models. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars within each group, and there is no visual emphasis on particular bars.
